# `octo/waivers`

Add `octo/waivers` to the `Octo-Capabilities` header to receive these fields.

- [`Booking`](#booking)
- [`BookingUnitItem`](#bookingunititem)
- [`BookingUnitItemWriteRequest`](#bookingunititemwriterequest)
- [`BookingWriteRequest`](#bookingwriterequest)

- [Schemas introduced by this capability](#schemas-introduced-by-this-capability)


17 fields across 5 schemas. The fields are additive: the base schemas are unchanged when the capability is absent.

## Schemas introduced by this capability

3 schema(s) exist only when `octo/waivers` is active.

### `Waiver`

Required: `id`, `title`.

- **id** (string (uuid), required): Unique identifier for this resource. Example: `"6d8c49eb-d6d3-4f03-a242-6f5f95f4d56f"`.
- **title** (string, required): Waiver title shown to the guest. Example: `"Participant Release and Assumption of Risk"`.
- **shortDescription** (string, optional, nullable): Short waiver summary. Example: `"Required before tour participation."`.
- **content** (string, optional, nullable): Full waiver markdown content. Field tags like `-First Name-=__` and `-Email-=__(\"type\":\"email\")` are parsed into `fields[]`. Example: `"I acknowledge and accept the risks of participation.

-First Name-=__
-Email-=__("type":"email")
-Signature-=__("type":"signature")
-Country-=__("type":"country")"`.
- **fields** (WaiverField[], optional): List of waiver input fields.

### `WaiverField`

Required: `id`, `title`.

- **id** (string, required): Field identifier parsed from the waiver markdown tag label and used in `waiverFieldValues[].fieldId`. Example: `"first_name"`.
- **internalName** (string, optional): Internal waiver field name. Example: `"First Name"`.
- **title** (string, required): Waiver field label shown to the guest. Example: `"First Name"`.
- **shortDescription** (string, optional, nullable): Optional waiver field helper text.
- **required** (boolean, optional): Whether the field is required. Example: `true`.
- **inputType** (string, optional): Input type parsed from waiver tag attributes (`type`) or `text` when not provided. Special types include `signature` (render as a signature box) and `country` (render as a country dropdown). Possible values: `text`, `textarea`, `select`, `radio`, `checkbox`, `date`, `number` (the specification declares this set on `Question`; here it types the field as a plain string). Example: `"signature"`.
- **maxLength** (integer, optional, nullable): Maximum accepted input length when configured.
- **selectOptions** (string[], optional): List of allowed values for select-style inputs. Example: `[]`.

### `WaiverFieldValue`

Required: `fieldId`.

- **fieldId** (string, required): Waiver field identifier from `product.waivers[].fields[]` parsed from waiver markdown. Example: `"first_name"`.
- **value** (string, optional, nullable): Submitted value for the waiver field. For `country` fields, submit an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (for example, `GB`, `US`). Example: `"US"`.

## `Booking`

- **waiverFieldValues** (WaiverFieldValue[], optional).
- **waiverFileUrl** (string (uri), optional, nullable): URL to the stored waiver file. Example: `"https://api.ventrata.com/uploads/waivers/waiver_booking_10045.pdf"`.
- **waiverId** (string (uuid), optional, nullable): Selected waiver template UUID. Example: `"6d8c49eb-d6d3-4f03-a242-6f5f95f4d56f"`.
- **waiversComplete** (boolean, optional): Whether waiver requirements are complete for this booking. Example: `true`.

## `BookingUnitItem`

- **waiverFieldValues** (WaiverFieldValue[], optional).
- **waiverFileUrl** (string (uri), optional, nullable): URL to the stored waiver file. Example: `"https://api.ventrata.com/uploads/waivers/waiver_booking_10045.pdf"`.
- **waiverId** (string (uuid), optional, nullable): Selected waiver template UUID. Example: `"6d8c49eb-d6d3-4f03-a242-6f5f95f4d56f"`.

## `BookingUnitItemWriteRequest`

- **waiverFieldValues** (WaiverFieldValue[], optional): Waiver field values for this unit item. Required with `waiverId` when submitting a unit-level waiver.
- **waiverFile** (string, optional, nullable): Optional base64-encoded waiver file payload for offline/in-person completed waivers, or to store a rendered waiver copy on the booking unit item. Use a PDF data URI such as `data:application/pdf;base64,...`. Example: `"data:application/pdf;base64,JVBERi0xLjQKJcTl8uXr..."`.
- **waiverId** (string (uuid), optional, nullable): Waiver template UUID selected for this unit item. Required with `waiverFieldValues` when submitting a unit-level waiver. Example: `"6d8c49eb-d6d3-4f03-a242-6f5f95f4d56f"`.

## `BookingWriteRequest`

- **waiverFieldValues** (WaiverFieldValue[], optional): Waiver field values for booking-level waivers. Required with `waiverId` when submitting a booking-level waiver.
- **waiverFile** (string, optional, nullable): Optional base64-encoded waiver file payload for offline/in-person completed waivers, or to store a rendered waiver copy on the booking. Use a PDF data URI such as `data:application/pdf;base64,...`. Example: `"data:application/pdf;base64,JVBERi0xLjQKJcTl8uXr..."`.
- **waiverId** (string (uuid), optional, nullable): Waiver template UUID selected for booking-level waivers. Required with `waiverFieldValues` when submitting a booking-level waiver. Example: `"6d8c49eb-d6d3-4f03-a242-6f5f95f4d56f"`.

## `Product`

- **waiverPer** (string, optional): Whether waivers are collected per booking or per unit item. One of: `BOOKING`, `UNIT`. Example: `"UNIT"`.
- **waiverRequired** (boolean, optional): Whether waiver completion is required before the booking can be used. Example: `true`.
- **waivers** (Waiver[], optional): Waiver templates available for this product.

## Integration notes

From [docs.ventrata.com/capabilities/waivers](https://docs.ventrata.com/capabilities/waivers).

### The waiver form is parsed out of the content

`waiver.content` carries the waiver text with inline field tags such as `-First Name-=__` or
`-Email-=__("type":"email")`. Every field parsed from it is returned in `waiver.fields[]`, so you
never have to parse the tags yourself — render the content inline, or build a separate form from
`waiver.fields[]`.

### Two input types need special rendering

- **`inputType: "signature"`** — render a signature box. Submit the drawing as a data URI, e.g.
  `data:image/png;base64,...`.
- **`inputType: "country"`** — render a country dropdown, and submit the **ISO 3166-1 alpha-2** code
  (`GB`, `US`), not the country name.

Every other input type renders as an ordinary field.

### Submitting

Standard submission needs `waiverId` and `waiverFieldValues` — an array where each record includes
`fieldId`. `waiverFile` is optional and may be sent at booking level or unit-item level; use a PDF
data URI (`data:application/pdf;base64,...`) to store a rendered copy of the signed waiver.

`waiversComplete` tells you whether the booking's waiver requirements are satisfied — check it before
confirming rather than tracking state locally.

### Level matters

`product.waiverPer` decides where a `waiverId` belongs: `BOOKING` means one waiver for the whole
booking, `UNIT` means one per unit item. Sending it at the wrong level fails with
`WAIVER_ON_BOOKING_ONLY` or `WAIVER_ON_TICKET_ONLY`, and a `waiverId` outside
`product.waivers[]` fails with `INVALID_WAIVER_ID`.
